title: spec(ui): an object-master-detail-form detail entry's sortField describe says it is derived when omitted; on the renderer's fast path nothing derives it
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect, class (c)**: published text teaches a behaviour the runtime does not have. `reach:` the sentence ships in `@objectstack/spec@17.6.0` (`latest`), in `src/ui/component.zod.ts`, `dist` and the JSON schemas, and in `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx`. Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 1 (`session_01UtnxvdiN376GF3sgXwAw4d`, seat post #6017). The source is the dev report on #21284 (`5945264989`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`), and the at-tier record `5945458961` on PR #21307 (③.2–③.3) ruled that a card is owed. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The text

`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` on `origin/main` holds the `sortField` member of the detail entry in `ComponentPropsMap['object-master-detail-form'].details[]` (the `masterDetailDetailEntry()` member list):

> `sortField` … "Child field holding the line sort position, stamped on drag-reorder (derived from a `position` / `sort_order` / … field when omitted)"

## Why it is false on one path (objectui at the `.objectui-sha` pin `31971ff1e28f`, `packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx`)

- **Fast path (967):** an entry that names `relationshipField` and types every column is returned unchanged, so an omitted `sortField` stays undefined, and 862 passes `sort_field: undefined`. Nothing derives it.
- **Hydrate path (1038, 1051) and derived path (1066):** these DO derive it. On these paths the sentence holds.
- `amountField` has the same fast-path gap, but its describe claims no derivation, so it owes nothing.
- PR #21307 (#21284) corrected the same one-path reading for the sibling `inlineMode` and `formFields` describes. This member was outside that card's ruling and surface.

## The retirement this meets

Record `5937457620` (on #20928, closed) notes that objectui `main` retired the authored `sortField` at `0a3e5409f` (objectui#11376), after the pin; its subject reads "a detail's sort field is derived only". So the `.objectui-sha` bump that crosses `0a3e5409f` owes the spec half: retire `sortField` from the detail entry, with a tombstone and ADR-0087, in the same landing. objectui#11396 and seat post #6017 name it. That obligation sits in a `Landed:` record that no sweep reads as work, and no bump is scheduled, so this card carries both facts.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- **Option 1:** a point fix now. Narrow the describe to the two paths that derive, as PR #21307 did for its siblings (`patch`, `Clause-②: no`).
- **Option 2:** fold it into the retirement landing at the pin bump. The describe then goes with the key, at the cost of the released sentence staying wrong until that bump.
- "Derive on the fast path" is not a live renderer option: objectui `main` has already retired the authored key.

## Dedupe

The 100 most recently updated objectstack issues and PRs, open and closed, were listed over REST and grepped locally for `sortField`. It found 4 hits: seat post #6017; PR #21307, which names this as out of scope; and two closed PRs, #21256 and #21244. None of them is a card that fixes this describe. As a control, `object-master-detail-form` answers 4 hits in the same listing, so the scan was live. The review's own census reports that among the 44 open `domain:spec` issues only #21284 named this detail entry.

Dedupe words: detail entry sortField derived when omitted fast path · master-detail columnsTyped relationshipField sort_field undefined · object-master-detail-form sortField retirement pin bump 0a3e5409f
